data.title: Residents' parking permit application rejected
data.summary: The City of Beispielingen (traffic authority) rejected your application of 21 July 2025 for a residents' parking permit for zone B 4. The vehicle is registered to a company and private permanent use by you is not proven.
data.explanation: Your application for a residents' parking permit (Bewohnerparkausweis) was rejected because the car is registered to Beispiel Pflegedienst GmbH and permanent private use by you is not documented. There is no fee. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically with a qualified signature, or on record at the city office. The app shows until when you can object. If you do nothing, the rejection becomes final. You could also consider submitting proof of permanent private use in a new application, and seek advice if unsure.
